title: Grip-trial curvature improves source-cohort cross-validation but does not demonstrate transferred digit-symbol prediction
abstract: Among 1245 NHANES2011–2012 training and 1397 NHANES2013–2014 confirmation adults aged60+, adding normalized absolute grip-trial second differences to flexible conventional strength and demographic measures reduced source cross-validated MSE by 2.987 score², but increased frozen-model confirmation MSE by 1.473 score². Both bootstrap95% intervals include zero. Incremental prediction was not confirmed.
